comment: Hand-transcribed expected ubus rc.list decisions for luci-mod-system-init and luci-mod-system-config from pinned uhttpd uh_ubus_allowed, startup.js / system.js rpc.declare, and ACL JSON. Not generated from the Python evaluator.
notes: uh_ubus_allowed requires session.access scope=ubus object=rc function=list (uhttpd omits scope).
Bounded to startup.js and system.js rpc.declare object=rc method=list at luci b2e0be4b. That is rpcd rc.c, not luci.setInitAction.
Fixture login luci-mod-system-init-read is read of the existing ACL group. Write luci-mod-system-init and luci-mod-system-config also match because write implies read.
Do not invent a setInitAction luci-ssl grant. rc.init stays on policy:ubus-rc-init-v1.
Missing SID is JSON-RPC ERROR_PARSE, not the all-zero sentinel.
Root list read/write '*' is stock rpcd.config, not a violation (expectation_id root-administration).
Do not emit dispatcher, authorization_violation, path_found, luci object grants, or a directory scan of /etc/init.d.
shellquote and basename are not sanitizers.
luci-mod-system flash.js write sysupgrade/firstboot stay unstaffed.
luci-mod-network diagnostics ping is not this slice.
crontab.js cron reload is not this slice (ubus file.write, not file.exec).

rule_refs: luci@b2e0be4b luci-base.json unauthenticated grants only luci.getFeatures
rpcd@d99f703 unauthenticated.json has no ubus rc.list
uhttpd@93b05e0 ubus.c uh_ubus_allowed: session.access rc/list false -> ERROR_ACCESS
do not invent an unauthenticated rc.list grant
uhttpd@93b05e0 ubus.c parse_call_params: missing SID with no_ubusauth=0 is ERROR_PARSE
missing SID is not rewritten to 0000... in luci-ssl-25.12

cases.note: Fixture login luci-mod-system-init-read is not a stock device login. startup.js uses rpc.declare object=rc method=list. Intended_access, not a violation and not a PoC.
rule_refs: fixture rpcd.config login luci-mod-system-init-read list read luci-mod-system-init

cases.note: rpcd write implies read, so the existing write luci-mod-system-init fixture also matches read ubus rc.list. Intended_access, not a violation and not a PoC.
rule_refs: rpcd session.c login_test_permission: write implies read
fixture rpcd.config login luci-mod-system-init list write luci-mod-system-init

cases.note: Existing luci-mod-system-config write fixture grants rc.list via write-implies-read. system.js uses rpc.declare object=rc method=list. Intended_access, not a violation and not a PoC.
rule_refs: rpcd session.c login_test_permission: write implies read
fixture rpcd.config login luci-mod-system-config list write luci-mod-system-config

cases.note: The list-read flash fixture has ubus file.exec, not rc.list. ERROR_ACCESS at uh_ubus_allowed. Do not invent a write flash login.
The read luci-mod-system-init-read fixture grants rc.list, not rc.init. rc.init stays on policy:ubus-rc-init-v1.
rule_refs: fixture rpcd.config login luci-mod-system-init-read list read luci-mod-system-init
do not invent a setInitAction luci-ssl grant

cases.note: luci.setInitAction has no luci-ssl delegated grant at luci b2e0be4b. This slice is rpcd rc.list, not the luci object method.
rule_refs: do not invent a setInitAction luci-ssl grant

cases.note: The write luci-mod-system-init fixture matches rc.init at uh_ubus_allowed. That grant stays on policy:ubus-rc-init-v1. This slice does not emit a rc.init grant.
Stock root list read/write '*' is intended_access (root-administration), not a violation.
rule_refs: openwrt@4e964251 package overlay rpcd.config root read/write '*'
